chapterInfo.content:
57
1 # 2 Ah 22.20 Ɔteneneeni yera,
na obiara mfa nhyɛ n’akoma mu,
na wɔfa mmarima pa kɔ,
a obiara nteaseɛ,
sɛ bɔne a ɛbɛba no anim na wɔyi teneneeni no firi korɔ.
2 # Yes 26.20; Dan 12.13 Ɔkɔ asomdwoeɛ mu;
wɔhome wɔn nnaeɛ so,
wɔn a wɔnante wɔn teeyɛ mu no.
Ɔman no bra bɔne
3 # Mat 12.39 Na mo deɛ, montwe mmra ha,
ɔbaabayifoɔ mma,
ɔwaresɛefoɔ ne odwamamfoɔ asefoɔ.
4Hwan ho na mogorɔ?
Hwan so na motrɛtrɛ mo anomu
na motwe mo tɛkyerɛma mu yi?
Ɛno, ɛnyɛ mmarato ne
atorofoɔ mma ne mo anaa?
5 # Yer 2.20, 24 Mo a mo ani so yɛ hyeɛ abosonnua no ho,
nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase,
na mokunkumm mo mmɔfra asubonhwa mu,
abotan mpaepaeɛ ase!
6Asubonhwa mu aboɔ torotoro mu na wo kyɛfa wɔ,
ɛno, ɛno ne wo kyɛfa,
nso ɛno so na wohwiee ahwiesa
na wode ayɛyɛdeɛ guiɛ,
yeinom so na me bo bɛdwo anaa?
7Bepɔ sorɔnsorɔn a ɛkorɔn so
na wotoo wo mpa,
ɛhɔ ara nso na woforo kɔ kɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ;
8na wode wo nkaeɛ adeɛ no
sii ɛpono ne aponnwa mu,
na wofirii m’akyi
kɔyii wo nnaeɛ so foroe,
na wobaee mu,
na wo ne wɔn dii deɛ wobɛgye wɔn no ano,
wopɛɛ wɔne wo nna
na wohunuu wɔn adagya mu.
9Na wode ngo tuu kwan de kɔmaa Molek,#57.9 Anaasɛ ɔhene.
na womaa wo nnuhwam dɔɔso,
na wosomaa w’abɔfoɔ akyirikyiri,
na wobrɛɛ wo ho ase kɔɔ Asamando.
10Wo kwan tentene no nti wobrɛe,
nanso woanka sɛ: Mfasoɔ biara nni so;
wonyaa wo nsam akwanhosan nti,
anyɛ wo ya.
11 # Dwom 50.21 Na hwan nti na w’akoma tuiɛ na wosuroeɛ,
na wodii atorɔ,
na woankae me
amfa anhyɛ w’akoma mu yi?
Me deɛ, ɛnyɛ komm a mefiri tete mayɛ
nti na wonsuro me yi anaa?
12Mɛka wo tenenee ne wo nneyɛɛ makyerɛ,
nso ɛrenyɛ wo mfasoɔ biara.
13Woteam a, ma w’abosompem a woaprapra aboa ano no nnye wo.
Na mframa bɛsoa wɔn nyinaa akɔ,
ohuo bɛfa wɔn kɔ;
na deɛ ɔdwane bɛtoa me no bɛnya asase no adi,
na wanya me bepɔ kronkron no atena so.
14 # Yes 62.10 Na wɔbɛka sɛ:
Montu ngu so, montu ngu so, mommɔ kwan,
monyi akwansideɛ mfiri me man kwan mu.
Adom ho bɔhyɛ foforɔ
15 # Dwom 113.5-9; Yes 66.1-2; Dwom 51.17 Na sɛ deɛ ɔkorɔn na wɔama no soɔ,
deɛ ɔte hɔ daa na ne din yɛ kronkron no seɛ nie:
Mete soro ne deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron,
ne deɛ wabubuo na ne honhom brɛ aseɛ no nkyɛn nso,
sɛ mɛma ahobrɛasefoɔ honhom anya nkwa,
na mama wɔn a wɔabubu wɔn no akoma anya nkwa.
16 # Dwom 103.9 Na merenham menkɔsi daa,
na me bo remfu daa,
ɛfiri sɛ honhom no firi me hɔ,
na me na mayɛ ahome.
17N’anibereɛ a ɛyɛ amumuyɛ nti na me bo fuiɛ
na mehwee no, mehuntae, na me bo fui;
nanso ɔkɔɔ so sanee n’akyi faa n’akoma kwan so.
18Mahunu n’akwan, nso mɛsa no yadeɛ;
na mɛkyerɛ no kwan, na masane makyekyere ne werɛ,
na mabɔ anofafa so aba ama n’abooboodifoɔ.
19 # Efe 2.17 Asomdwoeɛ, asomdwoeɛ nka deɛ ɔwɔ akyirikyiri ne deɛ ɔbɛn, AWURADE na ɔseɛ,
na mɛsa no yadeɛ.
20 # Yuda 13 Na abɔnefoɔ te sɛ ɛpo a ɛhuru kukukuku;
na ɛntumi nyɛ komm,
na emu nsuo pu atɛkyɛ ne dɔteɛ gu.
21 # Yes 48.22 Asomdwoeɛ nni hɔ mma abɔnefoɔ, me Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.

Na wɔbɛka sɛ:

Na sɛ deɛ ɔkorɔn na wɔama no soɔ,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
